claims.citation: New York Herald, 15 August 1866, p. 2, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Ship Alexandria (of Yarmouth, NS) Crosby, Liverpool,
47 days with mdse to Edmiston Bros. 11th inst., lat. 40, lon.
70, spoke brig Nebraska, from Boston, for Galveston dis-
masted; would try and get into Holmes Hole; wished a tug

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 15 August 1866, p. 4, col. 4
claims.verbatim: Alexandra, of Yarmouth, N. S., from Liverpool

Ship Alexandra, of Yarmouth, N. S., Crosley, Liverpool 47 days,
with mdse. to Edmiston Bros. 11th inst., lat. 40, long. 70, spoke brig
Nebraska, from Boston for Galveston, dismasted; would try and get
into Holmes' Hole; wished a tug sent to her assistance.
